summary: Launch Two Acquisition Corp. (Cayman SPAC, Nasdaq: LPBBU/LPBB/LPBBW) filed an 8-K disclosing Amendment No. 1 to its June 30, 2026 Business Combination Agreement with NuCube Energy, Inc. and Tesseract Merger Sub. The amendment extends the Outside Date to January 7, 2027 at 5:00 p.m. ET, permits pre-closing NuCube Series A-4 Preferred financings per Appendix A terms, adjusts Fully Diluted Company Shares so those issuances don't reduce merger consideration to existing holders, and increases the share reserve. No price, premium, board recommendation or advisor is stated. Watch financing dilution, extension risk and redemption dynamics.
